envelope.title: D-120 · Require human review of disputed closure
envelope.body:
A fictional recorded product decision. The quotation explains the reason; it is not a claim that this policy applies to every project.

D-120 is about Managed Cloud Migration: require human review of disputed closure so missing evidence cannot silently close an action.
